study: RevTrace Phase 4D diversity-aware active state-pair mining

selection.novelty: inverse frequency of the canonical state signature
selection.future_damage_proxy: earlier vulnerable token receives higher priority

deduplication: global hash of parent, canonical output/state, and divergent output/state
early_stop: one execution-shape probe per candidate; stop at 50 distinct pairs
claim_boundary: targeted mechanism population, never production prevalence
